{{Top|leg}}
A '''hyperaccelerated nerve implant''' was a technological body modification that sped up its user's reflexes to preternatural levels. Such implants were necessary for offworlders to survive on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Florn/Legends|Florn]], which was renowned for its extremely dangerous ecosystem.<ref name="CSWE I 282">{{CSWECite|I|282|Florn}}</ref>
